name: dsh-tui-secret
x-description: Secure secret entry for DeepSeek Harness TUI. A /secrets scene renders its own masked input (one bullet per keystroke, never the value or its length) and writes through the dsh credentials seam; it never registers a shell-env contributor, never logs a value, and never writes the credential document itself.

contracts.fallback: without the tuiScenes seam the plugin registers nothing and the TUI keeps running (no scene, no command)

commands.title: Open the secret manager (masked entry, list, delete)

permissions.name: commands.invoke
permissions.reason: open the /secrets scene from the composed command surface
